title: D2 advisory locks spec
description: Schema for contracts/advisory-locks/advisory-locks.spec.json — the source-of-truth catalog of PostgreSQL session advisory lock keys. Each entry declares a named lock with an explicit bigint key and the database it belongs to. A Roslyn source generator (D2.Shared.AdvisoryLocks.SourceGen) emits AdvisoryLocks into the owning-module assembly (currently D2.Edge.KeyCustodian.Infra) and enforces per-database key uniqueness at build time. Shared Postgres owns mechanism only.

constName.description: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE C# constant identifier, unique within its database.

database.description: The owning PostgreSQL database name (canonical D2 form: d2-{domain}, e.g. d2-keycustodian, d2-auth). Segments may use hyphens or underscores; both are split when emitting the nested C# class name. The same key value is legal in two different databases — lock keyspaces are per-database.

key.description: Explicit signed 64-bit integer passed to pg_advisory_lock / pg_try_advisory_lock. Caller-chosen — stable, well-separated values reduce collision risk. Must be unique within its database.

doc.description: XML summary text rendered on the emitted constant.

deprecated.description: When true, the entry is deprecated: the generated C# constant + factory carry [Obsolete] and the TS constant + factory carry @deprecated. Additive — the entry is NEVER deleted. Deleting a deprecated (or non-deprecated) entry is a breaking change the JSON-diff gate fails.

deprecatedReason.description: Plain dev-facing English explaining why the code is deprecated; rendered into the [Obsolete("...")] message, the @deprecated JSDoc, and the changelog entry. NOT a TK key (developer-facing, not user-facing).

replacedBy.description: Wire code of the successor entry (e.g. RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND). Must reference a real, non-deprecated entry in the merged registry. Omit for pure retirement with no replacement.

sunset.description: ISO-8601 date for the future RFC 8594 Sunset response header. Edge-runtime-deferred: carried on the contract now, consumed by the Edge response middleware when it exists. Inert until then.
